download_hero_desc: Install on any Windows PC or Android device. Choose the app you need.

setup_page_sub: Configure any device to act as an automatic announcement display
setup_electron_desc: No Chrome, no flags, no configuration needed. A dedicated kiosk app that runs fullscreen with autoplay built-in. Double-click and it works.
setup_run_admin: Run the downloaded QueueKiosk-Setup-2.1.0.exe as Administrator.
setup_done_shortcut: Done! A "Queue Kiosk Display" shortcut appears on the Desktop and auto-starts on next boot.
setup_tip_kiosk_url: Tip: After setup, configure the kiosk URL by setting the KIOSK_URL environment variable.
setup_person_kiosk_desc: Self-service touchscreen kiosk for generating queue tokens. People select an office, choose a service, and enter their details — no staff assistance needed.
setup_run_student_admin: Run the downloaded QueueKiosk-Student-Setup-2.1.0.exe as Administrator.
setup_done_student: Done! The person token kiosk appears fullscreen on the touchscreen and auto-starts on next boot.
setup_tip_touchscreen: Tip: On a touchscreen device, the OS virtual keyboard appears automatically when people tap the input fields.
setup_install_chrome_desc: If using the web version, install Chrome from google.com/chrome.
setup_run_script_desc: Run the automated setup script to register Chrome autoplay policy and create a kiosk shortcut:
setup_manual_chrome_desc: Create a Chrome shortcut with these flags:
setup_tip_startup: Place this shortcut in shell:startup for auto-launch.
setup_android_step1_desc: Open the display URL in Chrome on your Android device or tablet.
setup_android_step2_desc: In the Chrome address bar, go to:
setup_autoplay_policy: Set "Autoplay policy" to "No user gesture is required", then tap Relaunch.
setup_android_step3_desc: Tap the menu (three dots) → Add to Home screen. This creates a fullscreen app-like icon.
setup_android_step4_desc: Use any "Stay Awake" or "Kiosk" app from the Play Store to prevent screen timeout.
setup_ios_step1_desc: Open the display URL in Safari.
setup_ios_step2_desc: Tap the Share button → Add to Home Screen. Name it "Queue Display".
setup_ios_step3_desc: Go to Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access → turn it on.
setup_ios_step4_desc: Go to Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Lock → Never.
setup_linux_step1_desc: Install Chromium browser if not already installed:
setup_linux_step2_desc: Create a desktop autostart file that launches Chromium in kiosk mode:
setup_tip_raspberry: On Raspberry Pi OS, the display will launch automatically on next boot.
setup_mac_step1_desc: Ensure Chrome is installed. Download from google.com/chrome.
setup_mac_step2_desc: Open Automator → New → Application. Add "Run Shell Script" and paste:
setup_tip_login_items: Save the Automator app, then add it to System Settings → General → Login Items.
setup_mac_step3_desc: Go to System Settings → Energy Saver and set the display to never sleep.
workflow_page_sub: How the Smart Queue Management System works for officers, administrators, and the entire ministry.
workflow_sign_in_desc: Log in with your officer number and PIN. Your desk appears on the public display automatically.
workflow_call_next_desc: One click calls the next waiting client to your window. No shouting, no confusion.
workflow_serve_complete_desc: Mark the transaction done. The queue moves forward and data is logged for reporting.
workflow_manage_offices_desc: Add, edit, and reorganise service offices. Assign officers, set availability status, and control service offerings per office.
workflow_monitor_performance_desc: Live queue statistics, wait times, service volumes, and completed transactions across every office — all in one dashboard.
workflow_system_config_desc: Manage services, token counters, PIN resets, and system-wide settings.
workflow_review_feedback_desc: After each service, ratings from clients help track and improve desk performance.
workflow_attendance_analytics_desc: Track officer weekly attendance with login times, device info, and IP addresses.
workflow_eliminate_paper_desc: Fully digital queue management — no more manual registers, lost names, or crowded counters.
workflow_real_time_desc: Know exactly what is happening at every desk across offices.
workflow_fair_orderly_desc: First-come, first-served with priority assistance for persons with disabilities.
workflow_data_driven_desc: Reports on wait times, service volumes, feedback, and peak hours help leadership optimise resource allocation.
workflow_tts_intro: Hello and welcome. Let us walk you through the Smart Queue Management System.
workflow_tts_outro: Thank you for using the Smart Queue Management System.
